Same run: K=2 lookahead 1 1.116x, K=1 lookahead 2 1.174x (TTFT +9.6 ms, end-to-end 1.036x), K=2 lookahead 2 1.120x, K=3 lookahead 1 1.081x. The one speculative step past EOS lands after the stream and shows up as TTFT of a back-to-back request. Measured on bundle 2bd7fec7 (web-llm-qwen@4aa42f1); the shipped bundle 163177f1 (@21698fd) differs only in unload() teardown order and measured 1.137x (IQR 1.091-1.184, 6/6 exact) in a six-round paired sanity run (qwen-qwen17-fable-shipped-bundle-orca.json).

sources: webnn-workbench@1ff3cdaaab10a9ce740db208974974552f2ca719 docs/results.md (Qwen3-1.7B second pass; Explicit record of this pass)
caveat: All absolutes were taken while ORCA saturated the CPU. Lookahead hides CPU-side gaps behind GPU execution and a saturated CPU widens them, so the paired 1.136x is an upper bound for a quiet machine; the K=1 burst-tail component is load-independent but shrinks with output length. No quiet-machine number or projection is claimed.
